description:
I’m Prem, an Engineering Admission Counsellor supporting students across Maharashtra in choosing the right engineering colleges and branches based on their scores and interests.
I help students understand CAP rounds, cutoff trends, and option filling with clear and easy explanations.
My counselling approach is honest, practical, and student-friendly, focused on realistic outcomes.
My aim is to make the engineering admission process smooth, clear, and stress-free for every student.
